subject: gk
question: Which of the following is not a Maharatna company as of 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hindustan Copper Limited**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Hindustan Copper Limited (HCL)** is a public sector enterprise involved in copper mining, beneficiation, and smelting but does not hold Maharatna status as of 2024.
 
• Maharatna status is granted to select Central Public Sector Enterprises (CPSEs) based on key performance criteria like net worth, turnover, and global presence.
 
• Hindustan Copper Limited is classified as a **Mini-Ratna** and not a Maharatna or Navratna CPSE.
 
• Maharatna CPSEs include entities such as NTPC Limited, ONGC Limited, and Steel Authority of India Limited due to their significant contributions to the Indian economy and global operations.
 
• As of 2024, there are **13 Maharatna companies** in India, and Hindustan Copper Limited is not part of this elite group.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Maharatna Status:**

 
 
• Maharatna status allows CPSEs greater financial and operational autonomy to compete globally.
 
• Eligibility criteria include an annual net profit of over ₹5,000 crore for three years, a turnover of ₹25,000 crore, and a net worth of ₹15,000 crore.
 
• Examples: NTPC, ONGC, SAIL, and Indian Oil Corporation Limited (IOCL).
 
 
 
• **Navratna and Miniratna Status:**
 
 
• Navratna CPSEs have lower financial thresholds than Maharatnas but still enjoy significant autonomy.
 
• Miniratna CPSEs are classified into Category-I and II based on profitability and operational performance.
 
• Hindustan Copper Limited is a Category-I Miniratna company.
 
 
 
• **Hindustan Copper Limited:**
 
 
• Established in 1967, HCL is the only vertically integrated copper producer in India.
 
• It focuses on activities like mining, beneficiation, smelting, refining, and production of finished copper products.
 
 
 
• **Significance of Maharatna Companies:**
 
 
• Maharatna CPSEs contribute significantly to India's infrastructure and economic growth.
 
• They have the autonomy to invest up to 15% of their net worth in a single project without government approval.
